correctness.rationale: Source conditioning gives Cov(S,P)=2b q(1-q) F_b(q) with F_b=q^(b-1)(1-(b+1)q)+(1-q)((2b-1)q-b). The A-side source event has probability q^b, the B-side (1-q)^2; their changes to the expected wedge count reproduce both terms. For b=2 F_b=-2(3(q-1/2)^2+1/4)<0. For b>=3 F_b has negative second derivative on (0,1); exact rational supporting tangents at 11/20, 7/12, 3/5 rule out b=3,4,5 positivity; F_b(1/2)<0, F_b(5/8)>0 for b>=6, F_b(1)<0, strict concavity gives exactly two simple interior crossings and no extras. Exact b=6 witness 73845/4194304. Endpoints q=0,1 deterministic with zero covariance, excluded from strict classification.
residual_risks: Independent bounded checks are finite corroboration; infinite quantifiers depend on the reconstructed mathematical proof.
